note: How students greet a teacher, in class or passing in the hall.
Teacher to the class after explaining something.

back: Teacher, how do I do this problem?
note: Student asking for help with an exercise; 道 counts questions on a test.
Teacher checking the class understood; also between classmates.

back: Could you say that again, please?
note: Asking a teacher to repeat; in practice said gently, not as an order.

term: 老师，我能请教您一个问题吗？
reading: lǎoshī，wǒ néng qǐngjiào nín yī gè wèntí ma？
back: Teacher, could I ask you a question?
note: Respectful way to approach a teacher after class; 请教 is humble.
Asking a classmate, often in the class WeChat group.
To a classmate or the teacher.

reading: wán le，wǒ hái méi zuò zuòyè！
back: Oh no, I haven't done my homework!
note: Panicked realisation to a friend; 完了 = 'I'm done for'.

term: 抱歉，我把作业落在家里了。
reading: bàoqiàn，wǒ bǎ zuòyè là zài jiā lǐ le
back: Sorry, I left my homework at home.
note: Student to teacher. 落 is read là here: to leave behind.

back: Please hand in your missing homework.
note: Teacher to a student who hasn't turned it in yet.
Said rushing in just before the bell, to friends.
Teacher getting the class's attention.
Said when the bell rings; the teacher may say it too.

reading: lí xiàkè hái yǒu shí fēnzhōng
back: Ten minutes left until the end of class.
note: Teacher's time check, or a student counting down.
Asking a classmate about the timetable.
Talking about the timetable with classmates or parents.
To a friend before a test; 加油 is cheering them on.

term: 明天就考试了，我还没复习。
reading: míngtiān jiù kǎoshì le，wǒ hái méi fùxí
back: The exam's tomorrow and I haven't studied.
note: Classic pre-exam panic among classmates.

back: I'm going to fail this class!
note: University slang; 挂科 = to fail a course.
Asked right after a test by friends or parents.

back: I did really well on the exam.
note: Reply to 考得怎么样; modest people say 还行 instead.
About someone cramming before an exam.

term: 能借我看一下你的笔记吗？
reading: néng jiè wǒ kàn yīxià nǐ de bǐjì ma？
note: To a classmate after missing a class.

reading: máfan jiè wǒ yī zhī bǐ
note: To the person next to you; 麻烦 makes it polite.

back: How do you pronounce this character?
note: Asking a teacher or classmate while reading.

reading: qǐng bǎ shū fān dào dì shí yè
note: Teacher's instruction at the start of a lesson.
Teacher telling a student off.

reading: lǎoshī，wǒ néng qù tàng cèsuǒ ma？
back: Teacher, may I go to the bathroom?
note: Student asking permission during class.

reading: wǒ zuì tǎoyàn bèi kèwén le
back: I hate memorising texts more than anything.
note: Students complaining about rote memorisation homework.

back: Where do you go to school?
note: 读书 here means attending school, not reading books.

reading: nǐ shǔjià zuòyè zuò wán le ma？
back: Have you finished your summer homework?
note: Parents or friends asking near the end of the summer holiday.
